name: Wallpaper Gallery
author: Andreas Bylund
description: Browse a folder of wallpapers as a thumbnail grid and click one to make it your background.

barWidget.description: Thumbnail grid over a wallpaper folder of your choice. Click an image to set it as the background, middle-click the bar icon for a random one.

schema.label: Wallpaper folder
schema.description: Absolute path to the folder holding your wallpapers. Also typeable from the gear inside the panel; ~ and $HOME are expanded.

schema.label: Include subfolders
schema.description: Also show images inside folders within the wallpaper folder. Also toggleable from the gear inside the panel.

schema.label: Keep wallpaper across theme switches
schema.description: Installs a theme-set hook that re-applies your last pick from the gallery after a theme change. Also toggleable from the gear inside the panel.
